EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_URDA.title: Urda, Loamweaver
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_URDA.epithet: The roots beneath the floor remember your passage.
EZMB_URDA.title: Urda, Loamweaver
EZMB_URDA.epithet: The roots beneath the floor remember your passage.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_URDA.talk.firstVisit: The root remembers the first footprint. Choose where it will grow.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_URDA.talk.ANY.0-0r.a: Take only what you can keep alive. The rest becomes soil.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.description: Urda stirs beneath the earth. Four living bargains push through the bark.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_see: During Act [blue]1[/blue] normal combat card rewards, you may take a [gold]Seedling[/gold] instead: lose [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold] and add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Seedling[/gold]. The first [gold]Seedling[/gold] is upgraded. The [blue]4[/blue]th accept grants [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold] without healing current HP.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_hum: During Act [blue]1[/blue] normal combat card rewards, use [gold]Compost Reward[/gold] instead of taking a card to gain [blue]15[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. After [blue]3[/blue] composts, remove up to [blue]2[/blue] cards and receive [blue]1[/blue] upgraded card reward.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_mol: Remove [blue]1[/blue] Strike and [blue]1[/blue] Defend, then add [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Withered Husk[/gold] cards. At Act [blue]2[/blue] start, remaining [gold]Withered Husk[/gold] cards are removed.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_mos: The first Act [blue]1[/blue] Monster room grants [blue]25[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], Event heals [blue]5[/blue] HP, Shop grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Potion[/gold] if possible, [gold]Elite[/gold] upgrades [blue]1[/blue] random card, and Rest Site grants [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold].
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_tri: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]4[/blue] cards. It is upgraded, added to your deck, and marked [gold]Trial Plant[/gold]. Play it in at least [blue]2[/blue] of the next [blue]3[/blue] combats to keep it; otherwise it is removed.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_sha: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]2[/blue] common relics and gain [blue]75[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Defeat an Act [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Elite[/gold] to root it permanently and gain [blue]35[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. If Act [blue]2[/blue] starts first, Urda takes the shallow relic back and refunds [blue]75[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_roo: Urda marks a reachable Act [blue]1[/blue] combat in the first [blue]7[/blue] floors. Reach the [gold]Root Mark[/gold] to receive [blue]3[/blue] single-card rewards; the first is upgraded, and you gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Potion[/gold] if possible. Miss the mark to lose [blue]8[/blue] HP and gain [blue]25[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_aft: Act [blue]1[/blue] only. The first time you would die, prevent death, set HP to [blue]1[/blue], gain [blue]15[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold], draw [blue]1[/blue] card, add [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Wound[/gold] cards to the [gold]Discard Pile[/gold], lose [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Max HP[/gold], then spend this blessing. Before it triggers, each Act [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Elite[/gold] kill grants [blue]20[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], max [blue]2[/blue] times. If Act [blue]2[/blue] starts first, heal [blue]8[/blue] HP and gain [blue]75[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_roo: Gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Root Eyes[/gold]. Urda immediately marks [blue]1[/blue] reachable non-Boss room, then marks another after each room you enter. The first mark grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Potion[/gold] if possible.
EZMB_URDA.root_sight.map_hover.title: Root-Sight Mark
EZMB_URDA.root_sight.map_hover.descripti: Urda marked this reachable room. Enter it normally; the mark itself has no extra penalty.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_see: Use [gold]Store Seed[/gold] on Act [blue]1[/blue] normal combat card rewards to save [blue]1[/blue] offered card, max [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Seed[/gold] cards. Before the Act [blue]1[/blue] Boss, choose up to [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Seed[/gold] cards. The first chosen card is upgraded. Unchosen [gold]Seed[/gold] cards disappear.
Choose [blue]1[/blue] offered card to store as a [gold]Seed[/gold].
Choose up to [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Seeds[/gold] to add before the boss.
EZMB_URDA.pages.DONE.description: Urda's blessing sinks into the soil. The chosen path is set.
EZMB_URDA.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.ancien: The root remembers the first footprint. Choose where it will grow.
EZMB_URDA.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: Take only what you can keep alive. The rest becomes soil.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.title: Morvi, the Lender-Scribe
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.epithet: Every favor arrives with a margin note.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.talk.firstVisi: Ink is a patient creditor. Borrow carefully.
Every margin has room for another debt.
You know the weight of a bargain. Sign only what you can survive.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.talk.SILENT.0-: A quiet signature still binds. Read the margin.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.talk.DEFECT.0-: Even a perfect machine can owe interest. Choose the useful error.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.talk.NECROBIND: Revenge is expensive. I can advance the cost.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.talk.REGENT.0-: A crown is a promise to pay later. Your terms await.
EZMB_MORVI.title: Morvi, the Lender-Scribe
EZMB_MORVI.epithet: Every favor arrives with a margin note.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.description: Morvi opens a ledger and slides three contracts across the desk.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_f: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] upgraded [gold]Ancient[/gold] cards and add it as a [gold]Borrowed[/gold] card. Playing it costs HP: [gold]Attack[/gold] and [gold]Skill[/gold] cards lose [blue]1[/blue] HP; [gold]Power[/gold] cards lose [blue]8[/blue] HP. After the Act [blue]2[/blue] boss, pay [blue]180[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] to keep it if you can; otherwise Morvi removes it.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_m: Each turn, the first player-played [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold] plays [blue]1[/blue] additional time. If its base [gold]Energy[/gold] cost is at least [blue]1[/blue], draw [blue]1[/blue] card. [gold]Power[/gold], Status, Curse, autoplay, and generated cards do not trigger.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_r: At the start of each turn, add a temporary [gold]Overdraft[/gold] card to your hand if there is space. Once per turn, when your [gold]Energy[/gold] is [blue]0[/blue], play it to draw [blue]2[/blue] cards, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and record [blue]1[/blue] [gold]red-ink debt[/gold]. At combat end, each [gold]red-ink debt[/gold] costs [blue]12[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]; unpaid debts lose [blue]3[/blue] nonlethal HP each.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_o: At combat start, add [blue]3[/blue] random temporary [gold]Archive Pages[/gold] to your hand. Pages cost [blue]0[/blue], are [gold]Ethereal[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold], and are removed after combat. Pages can draw [blue]2[/blue], gain [blue]14[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold], deal [blue]10[/blue] to all enemies, make the next card cost [blue]0[/blue], or grant [blue]2[/blue] temporary Strength or Dexterity.

On turn [blue]1[/blue], draw [blue]5[/blue] extra cards and gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold]. At turn [blue]1[/blue] end, extra-drawn cards still in hand are sealed in the [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold]. At turn [blue]3[/blue] start, return as many as fit to your hand and make them cost [blue]0[/blue] this turn.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_p: At combat start, shuffle [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Waste Paper[/gold] Status cards into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. Each turn, the first [blue]2[/blue] Status cards drawn from the [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] are consumed; each draws [blue]1[/blue] card and grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold].
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_b: At combat start, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Proofread[/gold]. For each of your first [blue]3[/blue] non-Status, non-Curse player-played deck cards, unupgraded cards are temporarily upgraded for that play and then draw [blue]1[/blue]; upgraded cards cost [blue]1[/blue] less [gold]Energy[/gold] for that play and then gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold]. [gold]Power[/gold] cards are never extra-played.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_d: Immediately gain [blue]220[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], remove up to [blue]2[/blue] cards, and upgrade up to [blue]2[/blue] cards. Then set [gold]Debt[/gold] to [blue]320[/blue]. Each combat end, [blue]40[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold] comes due. Pay [gold]Gold[/gold] first; for each [blue]10[/blue] short, rounded up, lose [blue]3[/blue] nonlethal HP. [gold]Debt[/gold] decreases by the due amount either way.
Remove up to [blue]2[/blue] cards for [gold]Debt Settlement[/gold].
Upgrade up to [blue]2[/blue] cards for [gold]Debt Settlement[/gold].
EZMB_MORVI.pages.DONE.description: Morvi closes the ledger. The debt is written.
EZMB_MORVI.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.ancie: Ink is a patient creditor. Borrow carefully.
EZMB_MORVI.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: Every margin has room for another debt.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_LOTHA.title: Lotha, the Judge
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_LOTHA.epithet: Every strike is evidence. Every turn receives a sentence.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_LOTHA.talk.firstVisi: The court opens. Choose the law your climb must obey.
Speak once. Strike cleanly. Leave proof where all can see.
Rage may testify, but it will not be excused.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_LOTHA.talk.SILENT.0-: Silence is admissible. So is the knife.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_LOTHA.talk.DEFECT.0-: Metal records impact honestly. Let the record stand.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_LOTHA.talk.NECROBIND: The dead may speak through you. I will hear the evidence.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_LOTHA.talk.REGENT.0-: A ruler enters court as one voice among many.
EZMB_LOTHA.title: Lotha, the Judge
EZMB_LOTHA.epithet: Every strike is evidence. Every turn receives a sentence.
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.INITIAL.description: Lotha raises a mirror over the courtroom and offers three rulings from its docket.
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.INITIAL.options.lotha_m: Choose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Attack[/gold], [gold]Skill[/gold], or [gold]Power[/gold] from your deck. At combat start, move it to your hand if possible. The first time you play it each combat: [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold] plays [blue]2[/blue] extra times; [gold]Power[/gold] costs [blue]0[/blue], then gives [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold] and draws [blue]2[/blue].

At turn end, remember the last [gold]Attack[/gold], [gold]Skill[/gold], or [gold]Power[/gold] you played. Next turn, your first card of that type clears the echo: [gold]Attack[/gold] and [gold]Skill[/gold] cards play [blue]1[/blue] extra time; [gold]Power[/gold] cards cost [blue]0[/blue] and draw [blue]1[/blue].
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.INITIAL.options.lotha_p: At combat start, gain [gold]Innocent[/gold]. At the start of each player turn while [gold]Innocent[/gold], draw [blue]2[/blue] cards, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and gain [blue]8[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold]. When you take unblocked enemy [gold]Attack[/gold] damage, lose [gold]Innocent[/gold], lose [blue]8[/blue] HP immediately, and cannot regain [gold]Innocent[/gold] this combat.
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.INITIAL.options.lotha_c: Post-combat card rewards no longer appear. At the start of your first turn each combat, draw [blue]10[/blue] cards, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and your first [blue]3[/blue] player-played cards this turn cost [blue]1[/blue] less [gold]Energy[/gold] for that play.
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.INITIAL.options.lotha_d: On turn [blue]4[/blue], draw [blue]4[/blue] cards, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], and gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Verdict[/gold]. This turn, each next non-Status card consumes [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Verdict[/gold]. [gold]Attack[/gold] and [gold]Skill[/gold] cards play [blue]1[/blue] extra time. [gold]Power[/gold] cards cost [blue]0[/blue] and draw [blue]1[/blue]. If combat ends before turn [blue]4[/blue], heal [blue]4[/blue] HP.

Once per run, when your HP would drop to [blue]0[/blue] or less, prevent death and set HP to [blue]1[/blue]. Your reprieve begins on your current player turn, or on your next player turn if this triggers outside your turn. During the reprieve, draw [blue]10[/blue] cards, gain [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold], your cards cost [blue]0[/blue], and you cannot die. At the end of that player turn, if any enemies remain, die; otherwise continue the run.
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.INITIAL.options.lotha_s: Each turn, your first [gold]Attack[/gold] or [gold]Skill[/gold] plays [blue]2[/blue] extra times. After that, you can play only [blue]4[/blue] more cards this turn. If your first card before the sentence is a [gold]Power[/gold], it costs [blue]0[/blue] and draws [blue]1[/blue] instead.
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.INITIAL.options.lotha_p: When you apply a non-damaging [gold]negative status[/gold] to an enemy, double its stacks and gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Enlightenment[/gold]. When an enemy applies a non-damaging [gold]negative status[/gold] to you, double its stacks and lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Enlightenment[/gold]. [gold]Poison[/gold], damage-over-time, and countdown damage do not count. At the start of your turn, consume up to [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Enlightenment[/gold]. For each, draw [blue]1[/blue] card and gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
EZMB_LOTHA.pages.DONE.description: Lotha strikes the bench. The ruling follows you.
EZMB_LOTHA.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.ancie: The court opens. Choose the law your climb must obey.
EZMB_LOTHA.talk.ANY.0-0r.ancient: Speak once. Strike cleanly. Leave proof where all can see.
VAKUU.pages.INITIAL.options.ezmb_vakuu_f: Start a real fight with Vakuu. After your hand is drawn on turns [blue]1[/blue], [blue]3[/blue], [blue]5[/blue], and so on, Vakuu puts [gold]Temptation[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. This fight gives no normal combat rewards. Win to choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] non-Vakuu Act [blue]3[/blue] Ancient blessings if enough remain; otherwise continue without one. If you die, the run ends.
EZMB_VAKUU_FIGHT.pages.VICTORY.descripti: Vakuu yields. Three stolen Act [blue]3[/blue] Ancient blessings remain; choose one.
Vakuu yields, but no unclaimed non-Vakuu Act [blue]3[/blue] Ancient blessings remain.
EZMB_VAKUU_FIGHT.pages.DONE.description: The trial is over. The chosen blessing burns in your hands.
